text:
The code is syntactically correct and demonstrates basic use of `Counter`, but it does not meet the core requirement: it returns the top-5 words per file and concatenates them, rather than aggregating word counts across all text files to produce a single global top-5. It also only scans the immediate directory, not subdirectories, and does not normalize case or punctuation. Overall, it is a flawed solution.

Rating: [[3]]
